thread:
jessica.m: Hey team — Sunline interview follow-up. Customer is happy to do a short case interview next Tuesday. Need: one approved quote, logo usage ok, and legal sign-off on the blurb. Can we get a quick path to approval?

emma.cs: Awesome — I can run the interview. Prefer 30 min. Do we want to capture a short demo clip too? :movie_camera:

oliver.pm: 30 min sounds good. For the marketing piece, we want a 1-2 sentence quote about latency and cost savings. Draft quote below — @sam.legal can you fast-check?

oliver.pm: ```
"With Redwood, our inference latency dropped 3x while cutting per-token cost by ~40%, letting us ship faster and scale without breaking the budget."
```

sam.legal: Quick glance — the numbers need to be sourced. Do we have internal benchmark report ID or can Sunline confirm? Also need explicit logo permission from their comms lead.

jessica.m: Sunline can confirm the numbers in the interview. I'll request written confirmation and a logo asset. Tagging the customer comms: @Sunline_Comms (they replied earlier).

emma.cs: Scheduling options I proposed: Tue 10:00am PT, Tue 2:00pm PT, or Wed 11:00am PT. Which works for PM / Design?

tom.design: Tue 2:00pm PT works for me. Can take screenshots during demo for the asset pack.

oliver.pm: Tue 2:00pm PT works. I'll prepare the three-question guide: 1) baseline infra + scale, 2) what changed with Redwood (latency/cost), 3) business impact/quantified outcome. Short and focused.

jessica.m: Great. @sam.legal what exact phrasing do you need from Sunline to approve the quote? Also need their logo usage terms (e.g., only on web, press, social).

sam.legal: Prefer a one-line confirmation in their email: "We confirm these performance numbers are accurate and grant Redwood permission to use Sunline's name and logo in marketing materials (web/social/press)." That should be sufficient. If they require edits, loop me in.

emma.cs: I'll ask for that in my calendar invite. Calendar bot, please book Tue 2:00pm PT, 30m, Zoom.

calendar-bot: Created event: "Sunline customer interview" Tue 2:00pm PT — 30m. Guests: jessica.m, emma.cs, oliver.pm, tom.design. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890

jessica.m: Once we have the confirmation and logo, I'll draft the landing post and a short webinar teaser tying this into our upcoming "Optimizing Inference" webinar. Idea: publish a short case snapshot + CTA to webinar registration.

oliver.pm: Good plan. If we can get the quote approved today, design can start on the carousel and one-liner for the hero.

sam.legal: I'll standby to approve once Sunline's confirmation email is posted in this thread. If they push back on numbers, we'll mark it as "customer reported" and include a note. :ok_hand:

emma.cs: Sending the confirmation request now. Will paste their reply here.

jessica.m: Thanks — team, please react with :thumbsup: if you're aligned or drop objections now.

tom.design: :thumbsup:

oliver.pm: :thumbsup:

sam.legal: :eyes:

emma.cs: (later) Sunline replied: "Confirmed — the numbers are accurate for our Q4 baseline vs. Redwood after two weeks of running. You have our permission to use Sunline's name and logo on web and social. Attached logo (SVG)." Pasting attachment filename: sunline-logo-v2.svg

sam.legal: Great. That's sufficient. Consider the quote approved. Emma, please attach the logo file to the PR.

jessica.m: Perfect — I'll kick off the draft copy and share a short preview for approvals by EOD. Thanks everyone! :party-popper:
